programme.title: 疯狂历史补习社粤
programme.desc: 光绪帝身为堂堂大清国第十一任皇帝，何以游清源会称他为「穿著龙袍的囚犯」？「史上最强」直击「最苦命的皇帝」！入宫做太监先要净身，刀子匠可作代劳。清朝刀子匠全年无休，中原贱人馆介绍这行的入职条件。

programme.title: 疯狂历史补习社粤
programme.desc: 曹操有十五个老婆，另一方面却又长情又婆妈，究竟他是痴心还是黐线？心理医生为他进行洗脑疗法，企图洗走他一代奸雄之名。陶杰则教大家进军政坛前要先学曹操！另外，中原贱人馆的陈仔、罗拔创新推介乞儿「笋工」。

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤
programme.desc: 陆浩明与麦美恩组成「臭手」队；冯盈盈则找来「日本通」周奕玮相助，胜算大增！品尝日本熟成牛时，戴上耳机可提升饮食体验，当中播放的是甚么？6号、美恩所用的贴士是一幅艺人照片，答案呼之欲出！另类课程于学习舞蹈时加入浮夸表情，学成后便能带给别人欢乐？哥伦比亚旧城区住宅的门环反映出屋主身分，狮子门环代表哪一类人？曼谷经常塞车，犹如垃圾袋的衣服可发挥特别用途！两队答题表现不俗，偏偏于兑换汇率时抽中最低等级……

programme.title: 艺游巷弄粤普
programme.desc: 玻璃艺术工作者走出饱历挫折的创作路，在迷失中得到鼓励重新出发，把握重投玻璃创作的机会，更获得国际奖项，从与别不同的玻璃制作找到幸福。羊毛毡艺术家认清创作路向，用羊毛毡塑造出细致的仿造雕塑。听她细说「狩猎头别针系列」的创作历程与「藏山系列」之起源，从羊毛毡独特的颜色和质感，制作来自内心的创作。水泥艺术家将水泥制作融入生活，简约的创作风格，将水泥的本质以美丽的方法呈现，每件随身精品都流露出水泥的个性。

programme.title: 艺游巷弄粤普
programme.desc: 绘本皮革艺术家将绘本结合皮包创作，将天马行空、小幽默融入作品，设计出别致的皮包。从日本学习到大胆的用色技巧，带领学生在工作室享受自由搭配体验，乐在创作当中。剪纸艺术家从儿童绘本培养出对插画的兴趣，然后将故事丰富在剪纸当中，听她分享以「对称」说故事的概念，而她如何看剪纸创作？篆刻艺术家从传统雕塑获得灵感，在篆刻过程中发现古老文字演变的得意之处。另外，她亦擅于草书创作，听她介绍其中三项作品。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 爱丽丝即将在日光马戏团区举行特别演唱会，可是，露露娜却突然在索露露面前出现，还企图阻止爱丽丝开演唱会。索露露坚持这是爱丽丝想做的事，没人有权阻止，结果露露娜在一怒之下，令演唱会的音乐突然停止……

programme.title: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之羊羊趣冒险2粤普
喜羊羊与灰太狼之羊羊趣冒险2粤普
多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 小夫向大雄炫耀滑雪旅行，还挖苦大雄不懂滑雪。大雄不甘心，于是想练习滑雪。为了令爸爸停止打嗝，多啦Ａ梦拿出一件可令人大吃一惊的法宝。之后，大雄又想到把该法宝用于恶作剧。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露营少女粤日
programme.desc: 千明为早起提早休息，感觉到尿意，却被帐篷外的杂声吓得不敢去厕所。鸟羽带来了成吉思汗烤肉，葵和朱莉吃过后发现多年来在家中吃的竟非羊肉。踏入新学年，野外同好会继续向成为学会的目标迈进。

programme.title: 盲盒铁路游粤 及 无烟新进程粤
programme.desc: 主持们继续朝哈尔滨进发，却被突然告知在沈阳下车。踏足当地的著名早市扫街，东北大饭包、驴打滚，饱足的碳水早餐，还有沈阳人气小食铁板鸡架，丁丁指口感似薯片？参观沈阳故宫，了解满清族的历史根基。到访民国传奇人物张学良的旧居，还置身其喜爱的餐厅，品尝同款佳肴。凤尾西芹刀功精湛，香扇鹿筋更是满汉全席中的珍品。东北洗浴开箱「搓」体验，德德尝试陈皮、艾草汗蒸；两男肉帛相见被搓浴，贯东觉得自己像是被腌制的肉材？

programme.title: 饮茶粤
programme.desc: 饮茶只吃点心未必够饱，是时候点选一系列粥粉面饭食品，让大家分享。先从硕果仅有的粥车叫碗即舀的柴鱼花生粥、皮蛋瘦肉粥，然后前往广州登船吃艇仔粥，并听听荔湾艇仔粥的起源故事。干炒牛河是因做不到湿炒而生？此外，盈盈尤爱星州炒米，称摊冻后吃另有一番风味。至于面食，鸿图窝面、八珍窝面有个华丽名字，因何得名？枫馨自私食肉丝炒面，汁、面分开特别脆口！再来一碟扬州炒饭，要「炒冷饭」才算优质？而且它并非来自扬州？

programme.title: 饮茶粤
programme.desc: 最后一集以甜点作结才算圆满，除了传统中式糖水与糕点，融入西式元素也为茶客送上满满幸福感。怀旧甜点的做法不简单，玫瑰窝烧饼、糖沙翁买少见少；莲蓉西米焗布甸够香滑。萨其马、马蹄糕加入榄仁，口感有多特别？遮仔啫喱糕亦让盈盈重拾童年味道。芝麻糊、杏仁茶、红豆沙等经典糖水单吃、混搭皆宜，家英哥追求「黑白分明」，却要为盈盈特调「红杏出墙」？新派精致甜品显创意手艺，朱古力小笼包、龙须糖加开心果朱古力，滋味升华。

programme.title: 初入职场·中医季粤普
programme.desc: 《初入职场·中医季》深度聚焦中医文化，携手中医专业人才及中医助力团一起，通过"潮养生活"与"中医历练"，开启一场年轻态的中医文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: Gigi姐本集示范啤酒蟹，她提到最好用清淡啤酒煮海鲜较好，因为不会盖过海鲜本身的味道；她也教大家如何辨别新鲜的螃蟹、如何辨别公蟹和母蟹，还有令螃蟹更入味的方法。她也提到这道啤酒蟹可以做热荤或冷盘。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 样子甜美的乐瞳赢尽少男欢心，她却要透过学做甜品自我增值，朝著「100分女生」目标前进。浓郁芝士味道或会令甜品味道失去平衡，古嘉俊创作「黑芝麻芝士挞」时，将各种材料调配得洽到好处，同时散发阵阵和风气息。

programme.title: 星光魔法粤日
programme.desc: 阳比野祭视「星光魔法」上届冠军珍妮弗为偶像，自己也渴望参加，却因信心不足而踟蹰不前。喵姆从魔法世界来到人类世界，要寻找不懂魔法的丘比做拍档，一起参加「星光魔法」，然后她相中了祭。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 法国号是一种外型酷似大蜗牛的铜管乐器，以音色柔和见称。这次「My Little Show」的首位表演者已学习法国号八年，不妨细听由他带来的民谣演奏。随后，九位小女生「童唱」<Singing in the rain，为现场注入满满的欢乐气氛。皓谊姐姐与Tiffany姐姐联同结他导师，透过歌声宣扬「爱护动物」讯息，合唱<毛球和<最痛无声。Tiffany姐姐还忆述失意落泪时，获爱犬安慰的窝心事。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 改编自人气绘本。各位小朋友快跟著无人不知的名侦探屁屁侦探全面出击，透过细心观察及推理，侦破各类案件吧！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 爸爸出战业余棒球赛，更打出逆转全垒打，之后还教滨治等人打棒球，让大家重拾打棒球的乐趣。妈妈帮小丸子剪头发，但小丸子更想去发型屋，妈妈谅解的同时感到不舍，小丸子得悉后改变想法。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 人工智能概念股高估值，再加上加息周期重临的风险增加，第四季的「季度大比拼」，两位投资专家及AI挑战者，如何为新一季作策略性选股？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
星期日档案粤 及 无烟新进程粤
programme.desc: 今年为红军长征胜利90周年，长征为中国历史上重要壮举，本集将纪录香港及内地民众，在90年过后，到访长征出发地于都及终点吴起、延安，分享该段历史事迹，以及重走长征路的感受，从历史中认识过去。当中亦跟随曾以二百多天重走红军长征路的香港七旬老人郑镇炎，以及一群红军后代前往延安市，参观红军遗址。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 IV粤
programme.desc: 《警声百二秒 IV》引领观众「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭过去未来」，并继续以轻松有趣的系列表达方式，让市民接收丰富的警队资讯，说好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 北角某屋苑一楼单位曾两次被污水倒灌，不但浸满全屋，还波及地下大堂，源头竟是屋内垂直贯穿各层的喉管槽？管理公司一方声称是私人喉管，要事主自行处理。陆大状评论相关维修责任；测量师入屋视察，并提供应对建议。冷气技工Oscar方智弘因《女神配对计划2》人气急升，他展示清洗冷气机技术，还自言小时候并不帅气？另送上有助紧致肌肤的美容资讯。

programme.title: 中信银行(国际)Motion$呈献：试真D唷粤
programme.desc: 让朱敏瀚宁愿露宿街头的民宿，甫开门便涌出一股怪味。「战损版」梳化下更展示着满满的蟑螂尸体，加上CP值甚低，换来朱仔与GM零分评价。叫价140台币的鹅肉饭，以台北物价来说算不上便宜。网上评分只有18，主持们食后也一致负评。众人严阵以待试吃臭豆腐火锅，美仪姐尝后竟嫌不够要求加臭！店内还供应榴梿，让不好此味的振朗十分担心。面对榴梿加蓝芝士的臭豆腐，美仪姐吃得满足，但振朗痛苦得只能不断重复「很臭」评语。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：女神配对计划2粤
programme.desc: 甜品时间最后机会，若思获「大只」男公主抱，安全感满满！单独相处剖白内心，嘉敏与吴旭东回忆西安约会点滴。伍颂曦以猫、歌词进击珮文，女神却藉亲制蛋糕测试男方反应。沛珈与林福明藉画板加深认识，能否擦出火花？若思约会变星座、掌相交流会，大只男可符合一凹一凸的要求？可程、方智弘从儿时讲到嗜好，彼此距离拉近。甜蜜过后迎来残酷时刻，花生团淘汰四名男士，女神事前加持「保护盾」成复活关键！如女神获零票，也不能幸免？

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 谭咏麟(校长)于9月在红馆启动世界巡回演唱，骚前，《一周星星》主持许文轩曾探视校长练歌、排舞情况，「饮食」元素不能少，校长笑言自律性高，会避吃辛辣食物但必喝冻饮？文轩亦于演唱会第七场深入后台，为校长打气。香港站十场结束后，校长再应约接受专访，感受过歌迷的热情，可会收回巡唱「终极篇」的字眼与想法？回顾这趟演出，校长直言站在升降台某一刻，勾起其1984年首踏红馆开骚获父母支持的一幕，坦承因而有所感触！

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 张与辰推介铜锣湾的车仔面店，向老板娘请教卤制猪红的秘诀。食评家KC则推介海鲜私房菜，细味蚝皇扣澳洲黑金鲍鱼伴乌冬。美食KOL Arthur到访跻身全球101间最佳牛扒餐厅之列的食府，品尝直火烧烤熟成西冷扒及迷你牛尾汉堡。星厨莫灿霖推介酒店的扒房，细尝生牛肉他他及辣肉肠薄饼。施焯日与波波到葵涌光辉围一带「扫街」，遍尝石磨肠粉及特大炸鸡髀。元朗一间港式居酒屋推出39元拉面套餐连饮品，堪称「抵食」之选。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
飞虎3壮志英雄#12粤PG
programme.desc: 俊飞开枪打伤了Renee，此时飞虎队赶到抓了Renee，Leo逃走，而俊飞逃离现场时被展博看到。被打了毒针的杜文彬住院几日后康复出院。S小队开始调查DH2究竟在不在杜文彬手上。嘉轩邀许森回家跟轩父母一起吃饭，不禁忆起往事。

programme.title: 艺游巷弄粤普
programme.desc: 玻璃艺术工作者走出饱历挫折的创作路，在迷失中得到鼓励重新出发，把握重投玻璃创作的机会，更获得国际奖项，从与别不同的玻璃制作找到幸福。羊毛毡艺术家认清创作路向，用羊毛毡塑造出细致的仿造雕塑。听她细说「狩猎头别针系列」的创作历程与「藏山系列」之起源，从羊毛毡独特的颜色和质感，制作来自内心的创作。水泥艺术家将水泥制作融入生活，简约的创作风格，将水泥的本质以美丽的方法呈现，每件随身精品都流露出水泥的个性。

programme.title: 艺游巷弄粤普
programme.desc: 绘本皮革艺术家将绘本结合皮包创作，将天马行空、小幽默融入作品，设计出别致的皮包。从日本学习到大胆的用色技巧，带领学生在工作室享受自由搭配体验，乐在创作当中。剪纸艺术家从儿童绘本培养出对插画的兴趣，然后将故事丰富在剪纸当中，听她分享以「对称」说故事的概念，而她如何看剪纸创作？篆刻艺术家从传统雕塑获得灵感，在篆刻过程中发现古老文字演变的得意之处。另外，她亦擅于草书创作，听她介绍其中三项作品。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤

programme.desc: 肥妈到访老朋友家，用萝卜做出特色生菜包及「萝卜煮鱼肉片」，家中小朋友吃得津津有味。六号想吃贵价燕窝，肥妈用心寻找代替品，做出「杏汁雪燕」，雪燕是哪里来的材料？肥妈还创出全素的日式「淮山茶碗蒸」。

programme.title: 语你同行三十载粤
programme.desc: 「深耕三十载 ，语你谱新篇」，教育局、语文教育及研究常务委员会(语常会)三十年来，致力协助在香港推动两文三语。节目由星级艺员梁凯晴(Carina)、焦浩轩、语常会学生语文大使Anisah Hussain担纲演出，述说当局如何透过政策蓝图、拨款、教学支援、多元化活动等各方面，让本港市民，尤其是中小学生提升语文水平，进一步掌握两文三语的运用。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 大肠癌患者不一定能做手术，外科医生指病人要先接受评估。因大肠甚长，肿瘤处于不同位置亦影响手术难度；用机械臂施手术，则可增高精准度与缩短复原时间。医生呼吁大众参与筛查计划，从而及早发现。来自新加坡的艺员姚莹莹加入TVB逾三十年，要向大王澄清非选华姐出身！她最初没想过在港发展，皆因某港姐鼓励而做这决定？莹莹曾为减肥节食，但身型渐变肿胀，最终怎样修身？「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾奉上「蛏子牛蒡小炒」，镬气十足！

programme.title: 不老传说粤
programme.desc: 鼓手角色较为低调，陈友却了解到乐队不同岗位各有重要价值。他将半生奉献给娱乐事业，期间因工作打拼而过着非人生活，更曾忽略了宝贵亲情。艺名「陈友」因年少时态度傲慢得来，太太于多年前的患病经历就让他变得谦卑，同时学会重新分配时间，把生命中的人和事好好排序。陈友钟情音乐与游艇逾数十年，他会畅谈如何从嗜好寻获人生快乐。邻近荃湾港铁站的三栋屋博物馆，保存了二百年前客家人的生活面貌，邓梓峰实地感受这份简朴情怀。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「粤剧READY GO」环节，四位小朋友分成两组大玩问答游戏，从中探索粤剧世界，要抢答就必须跟步法走一圈。长平公主是哪一套粤剧的角色？又要看图分辨出粤剧相关的乐器与道具。而「Artspiration」则有玲玲姐姐教大家从「头」开始绘画一只变色龙，有甚么细节要格外留意？身体轮廓大致完成，就要画出关键的一双大眼睛，玲玲姐姐也对变色龙的广阔视角大感好奇。主持还以百洁布上色，为变色龙添上不一样的纹理效果。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 小夫炫耀钓鱼成果，大雄与多啦A梦用法宝帮爸爸制造大鱼鱼拓，却引发钓鱼决斗及海怪骚动。大雄以为蝉在树上筑巢，更被小夫发现，为免丑事传出，大雄用「坚持己见枪」令其他人配合自己的讲法。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望粤 及 富途证券特约:富途讲美股粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#45粤
programme.desc: 万里的住所因故停水，原需到街上轮候取水，幸得程祥剑安排送水，令嘉冰等人毋须为此奔波。另一方面，嘉冰到电视台为《当年好声音》试造型，亦因祥剑的关系获得不少优待。嘉冰盛装与祥剑重返母校，欲向当年批评其歌艺的老师耀武扬威，怎料遇上一名怪人纠缠，幸得祥剑及时带她离开。其后，有神秘人透过社交平台向嘉冰发送痴情讯息，更暗中跟踪她，原来正是在母校遇见的怪人；危急之际，祥剑及时现身将其制服，结果发现……

programme.title: 澳门上葡京综合度假村呈献：璀璨之城#1粤PG
programme.desc: 澳门尚利锋集团的董事会即将换届，主席官志琛宣布退位，引发长子官孝贤与幼子官孝君之间的激烈角逐。当孝贤自信能获得父亲支持，未料志琛打算钦点孝君接任。选举前，志琛突遭绑架勒索，孝君与妻子王雪莹全力奔走筹钱，孝贤则向董事施压，意图于父亲归来前锁定胜局，孝贤透过任职记者的情人郭芷媛，掌握董事会成员的黑材料，成功逆转形势。然而于关键时刻，有人推翻选举结果……

programme.title: 医生，你有病？粤
programme.desc: 卸下白袍，医生都是血肉之躯，就连行医数十载的蔡坚，也「坚不过石坚」，昔日能医百病，如今一身多病。77岁高龄，仍未退休，更坚定站在「前列」最前线，无惧尴尬公开隐疾，到底蔡坚为何如此坚持？

programme.title: 武则天#1粤普
programme.desc: 十四岁武如意奉旨入宫，因率直不跪龙辇，又挺身揭破贤妃小产真相，得罪韦妃；她无愿莲灯亦引起世民注意。

programme.desc: 通叔听到德云和村民说他们的坏话，小朋友更唱山歌嘲笑国光是老婆奴，怒不可遏。希敏得知自己最恨的父亲高天惹上官非，忆起十多年前高天送手镯作其生日礼物后竟去偷情。法庭上，高天指控女友偷去其心爱的手镯，但女方坚持手镯是高天所赠。希敏在法庭遇高天，不加理睬。国光认为希敏父亲不忠让她对婚姻失信心，决定设法修补父女感情。高天在庭上细诉手镯对他的重要性，不可能送人。国光偷偷带彦祖跟高天见面，希敏突然出现怒掴国光。

流行都市粤
programme.desc: 眼睛健康不容忽视，青光眼更是导致永久性失明的主要眼疾之一。有医学院在港推行眼科筛查计划，希望透过结合人工智能的检测新技术，及早发现青光眼、白内障等潜在眼疾。学者到来介绍这项新技术，并细谈推动筛查计划的点滴。「跟大厨去揾食」继续有黄隆滔师傅带路，推介星级版茶记美食。咖喱牛脷批酥脆香浓、豉油王炒通粉香气十足，还有吕宋芒果酱油占多等特色甜食，令人食指大动。「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐示范「合掌瓜焖咸鲜鲩鱼」。

programme.title: 不老传说粤
programme.desc: 邝美云（Cally）转营商界后把珠宝生意经营得有声有色，尽显美貌与智慧并重特质。她乐善好施，还积极推动内地建校，不自觉散发内在魅力。Cally生于基层，「知足」让她自小看透人生苦乐。每朝对镜笑迎自己，成为她保持心境开朗的秘诀。Cally钟情珠宝，皆因背后蕴含喜乐意味，她会细诉当年离开演艺圈投身珠宝设计的缘由。芷菁视驾车过程为品德修行，梓峰则享受在渡轮上放松心情，二人畅谈如何运用交通时间充实心灵。

programme.title: 才骏HASHTAG 中银香港「人民币财富管理」粤
老表，你好hea！#9粤
programme.desc: 丽敏配音时竟发现一直欣赏的声音，原来属于郭宝。林雪以酒引诱高音拯救伊健歌艺，高音只好答应。尤长参与丧礼时的一句说话，令尤田怀疑父亲有私生子，并认定就是在野。林雪发现高音昔日是歌手，求他参赛顶替伊健……

programme.title: 方德证券独家呈现:交易现场粤 及 方德证券独家呈现:交易先机粤
樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 六月梅雨季，阴雨连绵，小丸子心情纳闷，直至跟爷爷和姐姐在雨中散步，始发现下雨天的乐趣。滨治家中天花板漏水，小丸子教他聆听漏水声，其后滨治提议举行一场演奏会，小玉和花轮都带乐器参加。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这回，两对男生分别加入「曲奇」与「薯片」两大阵营，上演激烈对决！首先是「厂长话」游戏，有队伍靠着出色专注力，以全体零失误过关，获奖励零食秘笈。小心通过布满警报铃铛的果园执行收集任务时，曲奇兵团不到1分钟，就极速收集五个指定水果！虽然薯片小兵同样矫捷，可惜误取了非指定水果，些微拖慢了完成时间。压轴攻略「溶化之桥」，两队皆斗志高昂挑战高难度。最终双方成功运送的雪糕球总数均突破二十个，录得亮眼成绩。

programme.title: 面包超人粤日
programme.desc: 铁火小卷妹妹，与茶巾弟弟相遇之后，跟随他前往小镇。玛格丽特公主，想把花拿去送给面包超人，但途中遇到细菌人企图抢花。忌廉包熊猫碰巧路过并出手阻止但失败了。之后公主靠自己击退了细菌人。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 马百良六宝灵芝呈献:最强生命线粤 及 潮流生活志之格伦菲尔护齿大满足粤
programme.desc: 心肌肥厚是指心脏肌肉异常增厚，最常见类型为肥厚型心肌病，多由基因遗传或突变引起。患者心室壁变厚和僵硬，导致心脏正常泵血功能下降，可能引发胸痛胸闷、呼吸困难、疲劳，心悸头晕甚至晕厥或猝死。部分患者无明显症状，但运动时风险增加。诊断依赖心电图、超声心动图及基因检测，定期检查与避免剧烈运动至关重要。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
宏利保险呈献：湾区零距离粤 及 行政长官表扬榜粤
AXA 安盛呈献 :岁岁无忧粤
programme.desc: 三位「星级」嘉宾黎耀祥、陈自瑶、张驰豪分别代表「乐龄族」、「夹心世代」与「年轻专业人士」，各人受访细谈处于现时的人生阶段，对医疗保障的不同需要。究竟大家可如何做到「岁岁无忧」？

programme.title: 东张西望粤 及 富途证券特约:富途讲美股粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#46粤
programme.desc: 杨帆投诉杨光陋习多多，订立扣分制对付；杨光则不满杨帆将过失推卸给自己，又嘲讽他没有正职。杨光决心找工作，惜处处碰壁，得悉万里招聘多媒体制作助理，又见她力保犯错的希灵，遂萌生加入其团队的念头。杨帆设法阻挠，惟杨光仍成功获聘。此时，杨光突然接获韩国唱片公司邀请加入，猜出是杨帆暗中为他铺路，以免他加入跨世代遭万里利用。杨光坚持凭实力求职，兄弟意见相左。杨光经一番思量，打算为哥哥放弃职位，结果……

programme.title: 澳门上葡京综合度假村呈献：璀璨之城#2粤PG
programme.desc: 志琛在官家家族宝船「君临舫」活化开幕的致词中，暗示尚利锋董事会主席之位将由孝贤与孝君公平竞争，正式揭开兄弟阋墙的序幕。与此同时，香港检控官洪海允介入调查尚利锋涉嫌商业罪案，传召官家三父子问话，牵出围标官非与公司机密外泄的疑云。法庭上，海允揭穿一切，最终导致孝贤被迫暂停所有职务。及后，海允因遭指控「利益冲突」而升职受阻。在家族聚会上，孝贤宣布一个令人震惊的消息。

programme.title: 医生，你有病？粤
programme.desc: 医治ADHD的医生王玉珍，发现自己也患ADHD，如何能医又自医？专注力失调也能协调？过度活跃也有冷静时候？不单自己患病，还遗传子女，一屋ADHD，救人的医生，如何自救？

programme.title: 武则天#2粤普
programme.desc: 如意与萧蔷争夺《兰陵入阵曲》领舞，遭韦妃设计落选。她夜闯承庆殿戴面具起舞，意外与世民共舞，彼此留下深刻印象。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志之格伦菲尔护齿大满足粤
老婆大人#7粤
programme.desc: 高天因殴打Ada而被起诉，国光怀疑高天患有梦游病，希敏拒绝帮高天，国光责她被憎恨蒙蔽。希敏亲自出庭助高天。通叔知道高天是香港十大富豪，带著土产拜会，还带高天返围村，犹如衣锦还乡。亚基与昕昕宣布拍拖。高天劝敏珍惜国光，给他多点自由和尊重。希敏得悉高天知道婚前协议书一事质问国光，国光怒然反驳。国光决定跟朋友合作搞多媒体公司，希敏与昕昕一席话后，决定申请放大假，学做家庭主妇，智雄却刚推荐她当主任裁判官。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 眼睛健康不容忽视，青光眼更是导致永久性失明的主要眼疾之一。有医学院在港推行眼科筛查计划，希望透过结合人工智能的检测新技术，及早发现青光眼、白内障等潜在眼疾。学者到来介绍这项新技术，并细谈推动筛查计划的点滴。「跟大厨去揾食」继续有黄隆滔师傅带路，推介星级版茶记美食。咖喱牛脷批酥脆香浓、豉油王炒通粉香气十足，还有吕宋芒果酱油占多等特色甜食，令人食指大动。「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐示范「合掌瓜焖咸鲜鲩鱼」。

programme.title: 不老传说粤
programme.desc: 邝美云（Cally）转营商界后把珠宝生意经营得有声有色，尽显美貌与智慧并重特质。她乐善好施，还积极推动内地建校，不自觉散发内在魅力。Cally生于基层，「知足」让她自小看透人生苦乐。每朝对镜笑迎自己，成为她保持心境开朗的秘诀。Cally钟情珠宝，皆因背后蕴含喜乐意味，她会细诉当年离开演艺圈投身珠宝设计的缘由。芷菁视驾车过程为品德修行，梓峰则享受在渡轮上放松心情，二人畅谈如何运用交通时间充实心灵。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#9粤
programme.desc: 丽敏配音时竟发现一直欣赏的声音，原来属于郭宝。林雪以酒引诱高音拯救伊健歌艺，高音只好答应。尤长参与丧礼时的一句说话，令尤田怀疑父亲有私生子，并认定就是在野。林雪发现高音昔日是歌手，求他参赛顶替伊健……

programme.title: 高朋满座#205粤
programme.desc: 火爷发现爱女朱大有作为。内心却感寂寞，可是朱无所觉，在工余时更找悦外出购物减压，丝毫没有察觉老父的寂寞。朱惊见父亲在公园内与人下棋的情景，方醒悟父亲需要名爱侣陪伴在侧，令朱暗起替父亲再找伴侣的信念。

programme.title: 玉楼春#19粤普
programme.desc: 沈氏和少春在路上碰到柳三绝，二人神色有异，可是却否认认识对方。桃夭派人把玉佩还给世杰，世杰来听桃夭唱曲，动了真情。桃夭一直等著世杰登门，这天世杰终于来了，二人聊起了月红，桃夭让世杰好好对待月红。

programme.title: 美女厨房粤PG
programme.desc: 三位经常语出惊人的女艺员，不谋而合走进厨房，继续发挥本性，做出多项令人忍不住喝止的行为！卖相恶心、火烧厨房，都总好过有人奉上全生的鸡腿卷！单文柔亲自为陈展鹏烹调天妇罗，展鹏的感觉便成为今集主题。为符合「今生无悔，死而无憾」的主题，大家都将潜藏的恐怖厨神基因释出，煮出黑暗八爪鱼。有人为求抢分数，向厨师评判喂食，阮兆祥直言不受这一套。相反，胡鸿钧备受威胁，给予大量感情分数，令赛果更加难以预计。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 裸婚时代
programme.desc: 【八年爱情遇上现实婚后生活秒变修罗场】刘易阳与童佳倩相恋八年，决定在怀孕之际不顾家境悬殊与双方父母的强烈反对，选择没房、没车、没钻戒、没婚礼的「裸婚」。两人原以为爱情足以抵挡现实，但婚后却发现，与易阳父母同住的压力、两家价值观的冲突，以及柴米油盐的重担正逐步侵蚀他们的浪漫。当理想被生活逼到墙角，这对一路走来的恋人，究竟能否守住最初的承诺，为爱打下一个真正的家？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 模范刑警
programme.desc: 【孙贤周携手张胜祖，最强刑警搭档追查冤案揭开真相！！】资深刑警姜道昌凭经验与直觉，与只相信证据的天才刑警吴志赫成了新搭档。两人办案风格迥异，从冲突到合作，逐渐建立默契。面对五年前女高中生遇害的案件出现新的疑点，两人联手出击揭开掩盖的真相，对抗试图隐瞒冤案的权力与势力找出真凶。

programme.title: 极速悖论
programme.desc: 【超越速度的爱情故事，不只想见柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，赛车场上大谈13岁差姊弟恋！！】从小将赛车作为梦想的陈墨白，最大目标就是登上超级方程式赛场。碰上了贵为空气动力学工程师的沈溪，却隐身为办公室的打杂小妹。彼此成为重要的陪伴，赛车场上超越速度也突破两人心魔，共同为了梦想努力。

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 模范刑警
programme.desc: 【孙贤周携手张胜祖，最强刑警搭档追查冤案揭开真相！！】资深刑警姜道昌凭经验与直觉，与只相信证据的天才刑警吴志赫成了新搭档。两人办案风格迥异，从冲突到合作，逐渐建立默契。面对五年前女高中生遇害的案件出现新的疑点，两人联手出击揭开掩盖的真相，对抗试图隐瞒冤案的权力与势力找出真凶。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 极速悖论
programme.desc: 【超越速度的爱情故事，不只想见柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，赛车场上大谈13岁差姊弟恋！！】从小将赛车作为梦想的陈墨白，最大目标就是登上超级方程式赛场。碰上了贵为空气动力学工程师的沈溪，却隐身为办公室的打杂小妹。彼此成为重要的陪伴，赛车场上超越速度也突破两人心魔，共同为了梦想努力。

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时(完)
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.desc: 麦克原本拥有完美又快乐的生活，直到意外发现家里刚收养的孩子，竟然是打算入侵地球的南瓜星人！于是联合同学塞尔、科学家西蒙、酷女孩莱特，试图阻止南瓜星人的入侵计划！

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 裸婚时代
programme.desc: 【八年爱情遇上现实婚后生活秒变修罗场】刘易阳与童佳倩相恋八年，决定在怀孕之际不顾家境悬殊与双方父母的强烈反对，选择没房、没车、没钻戒、没婚礼的「裸婚」。两人原以为爱情足以抵挡现实，但婚后却发现，与易阳父母同住的压力、两家价值观的冲突，以及柴米油盐的重担正逐步侵蚀他们的浪漫。当理想被生活逼到墙角，这对一路走来的恋人，究竟能否守住最初的承诺，为爱打下一个真正的家？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 模范刑警
programme.desc: 【孙贤周携手张胜祖，最强刑警搭档追查冤案揭开真相！！】资深刑警姜道昌凭经验与直觉，与只相信证据的天才刑警吴志赫成了新搭档。两人办案风格迥异，从冲突到合作，逐渐建立默契。面对五年前女高中生遇害的案件出现新的疑点，两人联手出击揭开掩盖的真相，对抗试图隐瞒冤案的权力与势力找出真凶。

programme.title: 极速悖论
programme.desc: 【超越速度的爱情故事，不只想见柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，赛车场上大谈13岁差姊弟恋！！】从小将赛车作为梦想的陈墨白，最大目标就是登上超级方程式赛场。碰上了贵为空气动力学工程师的沈溪，却隐身为办公室的打杂小妹。彼此成为重要的陪伴，赛车场上超越速度也突破两人心魔，共同为了梦想努力。

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Global Gameshow
programme.desc: It's the Go Jetters as you've never seen them before as they take part in a disco dazzling around the world gameshow! Foz and Xui are on Team Go Jetters and Grandmaster Glitch and Kyan are on Team Glitch as they go head-to-head to see who will win! After coming in neck and neck after the first quiz round, the teams then head outside to take part in the ultimate geographic assault course where, in the end, it's all down the Foz to take his time and use his problem solving powers...

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Butterflies
programme.desc: Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Burger Shop
programme.desc: It's time for Bluey and Bingo to get out of the bath. But Dad has decided not to tell them what to do and gets roped into a game of Burger Shop.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hatzegopteryx Display
programme.desc: When Jen's drone goes missing on Dino Island, Andy heads out to track it down. He discovers one of the island's inhabitants, a giraffe-sized pterosaur, called Hatzegopteryx, is using the drone for a very special purpose.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Rubber Duck
programme.desc: In the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie play a game of Hide-and-Quack with the Playtimers to find their missing rubber ducks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Whistling Badge
programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Music Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, tubes and some water later and the Squirrels are making music. And boy, are they LOUD!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Imagination Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels tell Duggee that they have nothing left to play with, he encourages them to use their imagination.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch invents the world's most pungent perfume, he finds he needs one more ingredient: the super stinky aroma of the titan arum, a huge flower that blooms once every few years in the rainforests of Sumatra.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Bonneville Salt Flats, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters arrive at the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, USA - a huge dry lakebed that's perfect for high-speed driving. Lars unveils the Turbo Zoomster, a racecar made for Xuli to break the Go Jet land speed record. Suddenly, Grandmaster Glitch arrives at the wheel of his suped-up dragster. He once lost a race to the current record holder, Ubercorn, and now he's back for a second go.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Free The Roads
programme.desc: Bulgy thinks that people should travel by bus instead of rail, that is until he tries carrying all their passengers.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Picture Planes
programme.desc: When Sarah and Duck are racing paper planes, they chance upon an exciting discovery.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Hat Fuss
programme.desc: Scarf Lady needs some fresh inspiration and Sarah decides that the Hat Museum is the perfect place to visit.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Noisy Night
programme.desc: There's a funny noise around town. It's distracting the children's music practice and keeping everyone else up. Stanley investigates with the help of Myrtle.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Delivery
programme.desc: Stanley helps Hattie, Fred, and Fifi with a new food delivery service. It starts well, except with each delivery a problem arises. Stanley must solve them before Myrtle's party.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Just Like Worms
programme.desc: From snails called David to Daddy Spider Longlegs', the funny animals talk about all things creepy and crawly.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to look at old pictures
programme.desc: A photo of Gran Gran and JoJo's mummy when she was a little girl inspires them to take a walk and compare old photos of their neighbourhood to see how it has changed over time.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk

Meanwhile, Glitch has uprooted trees on the side of a large hill in order to build his rival Grim Dome Academy. But the lack of tree roots holding the soil together and the heavy rainfall leads to a mudslide! Glitch and his cadets need rescuing before they are washed away down the hill. Can the Go Jetters - with help from the Academy cadets - take on the power of the mudslide?

programme.desc: Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Horsetail Fall, California
programme.desc: The team are at Horsetail Fall in the Yosemite Nation Park to watch the 300m high waterfall become Firefall. This happens once a year when the setting sun melts the snow and lights up the water making it glow like fire for a few special minutes. But Glitch has frozen the waterfall to try and save his snow princess, Glorinda, from melting! Can the Go Jetters get enough snow to melt to enable Firefall to happen by the time the sun is in the right position as well as saving Princess Glorinda?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Yoga Ball
programme.desc: Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy Goes Fishing on Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is studying the undiscovered prehistoric fish that live on Dino Island and Andy goes on a fishing adventure.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cotton Wool
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Tincy in the Sing Song Forest. How will she get all the snowballs out of her spiderweb? The Playtimers must sing and shout until they all fall out!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shape Badge
programme.desc: It is a lovely day and the squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Whistling Badge
programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Making Music Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, tubes and some water later and the Squirrels are making music. And boy, are they LOUD!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Artificial Reef
programme.desc: Kyan, Lars and Foz pick up litter on the Academy beach after a storm, while Xuli dives down to check the coral reef. She spots something in the murky depths: a huge rusty submarine lies across the reef, and the moustache on the bow means it must belong to Grandmaster Glitch. What's worse, it's leaking oil!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch invents the world's most pungent perfume, he finds he needs one more ingredient: the super stinky aroma of the titan arum, a huge flower that blooms once every few years in the rainforests of Sumatra.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Chucklesome Trucks
programme.desc: When Rebecca works with the Troublesome Trucks, everyone expects the worst, but she defies everyone's expectations and has a very amusing day.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Hat Fuss
programme.desc: Scarf Lady needs some fresh inspiration and Sarah decides that the Hat Museum is the perfect place to visit.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Dewy Morning
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck are so keen to visit the art shop, they get there too early and have to find things to keep themselves entertained.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Can-Bots
programme.desc: Stanley is very busy, so he invents three little robots called the Can Bots to help. They begin well but soon start getting out of hand. Stanley has some reprogramming to do.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Noisy Night
programme.desc: There's a funny noise around town. It's distracting the children's music practice and keeping everyone else up. Stanley investigates with the help of Myrtle.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Could Be The Best Dancer In The Whole Entire World
programme.desc: From disco dancing frogs to skipping puffins and lions that love ballet, the talking animals discuss the best things about dancing.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to dance
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Honey Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Tadpole Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Treehouse Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning the clubhouse so the squirrels take refuge in the treehouse, but it's getting a little bit cramped these days. Norrie has an idea - maybe they need to add an extension.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Great Pacific Garbage Patch
programme.desc: When a storm washes up lots of plastic litter onto the Go Jet Academy beach, the Go Jetters leave Ubercorn, Grandmaster Glitch and the cadets behind and head to the Pacific Ocean to try to solve the problem of the Great Pacific Garbage Patch. This is a massive collection of plastic garbage which has gathered together and floats in the ocean. It causes big problems for animals and sea birds which live in the oceans as they can eat the garbage or get tangled up in it. Sorting this out is going to

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Mango
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the magical wish granter Mango, ready to make all the Roots and Fruits cast wishes come true.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Fig
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the nicest, kindest, Fig, performing his song, "Just Can't Help Being Sweet!"

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Evil Pea's Big Freeze
programme.desc: Chilli's heat helps Supertato to stop Evil Pea from freezing over the whole supermarket.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Cheese Moon
programme.desc: It's a space race to fulfil Carrot's dream of being the first Veggie on the cheese moon.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Cold
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are warm, inside. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion. Award winning actor Ku Feng is his eq

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies' man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the family's fortune.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. It's not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.desc: 节目邀请到大家熟悉的「万人美老师」－郭昱晴担任主持人。以系列为节目核心，邀请在相同体系内，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其坚守追求专业的精神与受挫不懈的毅力。并且将依照不同专业，结合生活观点，推出相符的小单元。内容兼具权威与风趣，不仅拉近观众与来宾距离，也从中看到来宾不为人知的另一面。如节目中热血仁医系列，除了分享医生在白色巨塔中奋斗的故事之外，也会依其专业，在预防医学的概念下，加入医疗科技新资讯及独门养生撇步等小单元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第1集
programme.desc: 此音只应天上有，人间哪得几回闻。」「梵呗」就是清净之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心灵的清净，歌咏时还伴以管、弦或敲击乐器，普及佛教教义。

programme.title: 好好玩自然第30集
programme.desc: 想成为生态达人吗？喜爱悠游山海丛林、与动物昆虫亲近的小朋友别错过啰！就让柳丁哥哥与生态专家阿峰，带你探索台湾丰富的自然生态， 与各种动物做朋友，一起揭开大自然的神秘面纱！

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1852集
programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第342集
programme.desc: 由人气主持人携手多位蔬食名厨，现场烹调精致美味的蔬食餐点，让您大饱眼福，也大饱口福。

programme.desc: 热闹的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母亲雅芬穿过拥挤的人群，来到生意兴隆、美军也来光顾的「宝岛西服店」，寻找失踪的父亲照清。照清曾在这里当过学徒，和老板梅树师是师兄弟，但因故未能出师…。春燕看著梅树与晓兰鹣鲽情深地经营「宝岛西服店」，这美好的景象让春燕想起父亲曾向自己承诺，未来若跟著师兄梅树出师后，自己的西服店也会正式挂牌营业，并收女儿春燕当全台第一位西装女徒弟，将西装技艺传承下去

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第29集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 人文讲堂第609集
programme.desc: 《人文讲堂》节目，邀请台湾各行各业杰出人士、学者专家，或热爱生命者，将多年的学识涵养、人文感受，以及对生命的活力，以讲演方式，直接与大众分享。讲演的内容及方式，不再流于传统，不仅是知识或专业技术而已，更会呈现出特有的人文观点。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 今天爱上我第5集

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第57集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧语第366集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧来自于内心，由内心启悟的智慧也最真实。证严 上人说：「做该做的事就是智慧，做不该做的事就是愚痴。」十个问题、十个解方，都是言者生命经验的体现，透过名人的智慧哲理，足以启迪人心，振聋发瞆，重新思考人生的价值。

programme.title: 快乐小蘑菇第40集
programme.desc: 这是一部以学前幼儿人文与品格教育为主的节目，从孩子的行为为动机，透国内外相关绘本为讲述故事，借由孩子发现问题来省思并静思，最后再实现到生活中。内容分别都是学龄前孩子会出现的行为，如：抢玩具，分享，礼仪，害怕，不喜欢自己，生死，感恩，惜福...…等，适合全家，师生，教育工作者，一起欣赏…

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第203集

programme.title: 行动现场第500集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 综艺玩很大第595集
programme.desc: ｢综艺玩很大｣由亚洲娱乐天王吴宗宪、小鬼黄鸿升主持， 每集任务关卡无极限，来宾个个拼得你死我活， 不只玩很大，更跟你玩真的， 到底艺人们为了输赢能多牺牲？ 中视周六晚上10点【综艺玩很大】

programme.title: MIT台湾志第742集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第2099集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1414集

programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 天赋异禀的六扇门女捕快袁今夏（谭松韵饰）因为一桩案件和性情狠辣的锦衣卫陆绎（任嘉伦饰）结下梁子，本是道不同不相为谋，却因惊天密案联手。两人从水火不容到情难自已，命运的纠葛就此旋转一起。

programme.title: 霹雳邪章之道劫龙战第11集
programme.desc: 邪章现，魔册十变；道劫起，龙战千里：末天阎劂造烽烟，寰定乾坤命太玄。七仙恩怨，纠缠不休，午晦明夷再现武林，意图不轨，此时但见漫天虹光，旖旎炫目，伴随一道雷霆剑气轰然而下的，是身形娇小、年华荳蔻，却盛气凌人，誓斩叛徒的凌虚小道仙。

programme.title: 音乐大霹雳第191集
programme.desc: 震撼十足的世纪曲风扣人心弦的霹雳乐曲动听的霹雳配乐 超人气偶像精彩ｍｖ邀您一起共谱霹雳音乐幻境

programme.title: PILI英雄同乐会第327集
programme.desc: 霹雳娱乐资讯节目《PILI英雄同乐会》，每周【霹雳公开亭】单元介绍霹雳布袋戏最新活动资讯与新闻，并带来超人气【霹雳英雄榜】、【好戏再安可】等单元，与霹雳戏迷们同乐。

programme.title: 仙界小霹雳第12集
programme.desc: 仙界的茶壶小学是小神兽们修仙炼丹、学习如何降妖伏魔的地方。小水龙跩鸭、小石狮多莉、小麒麟天财还有小天狗旺福是经常玩在一块的好朋友，他们在校长太上老君、风狮爷和洪牡丹等师长陪伴下，一起学习「为仙处事」的道理。

programme.title: 整你的人生第5集

programme.title: 霹雳朝灵阙第12集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，无暇暗劫起，猂族利用地狱鸟力量，动荡苦境之后，雌伏多年的暗劫八无暇，也趁势再出，为阻止这股邪恶势力颠覆中原武林，汤问梦泽山座白象．香六牙，广发天下举锋帖，召开擎天会，聚集西窗月、墨如鸦、不全鹰等汤问英杰，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道释代表相继响应，血漫河山侠骨烈，亘古之争，胜败由天抑由人？

programme.title: 霹雳侠影之轰霆剑海录第46集
programme.desc: 神州动荡，武林危难，森狱大举入侵，逆海崇帆灭亡，黑海森狱崛起，玄嚣太子领导众多强将，一举攻陷武林。同为皇储，玄灭太子也伺机而出，与玄嚣一争苦境版图，要将森狱版图扩张至苦境，完成个人霸业，以便未来继承阎王之位。道门六杰挺身而出，倦收天与银骠当家等携手抵抗，唯慕峥嵘私心自用，导致无辜伤亡，最终遭受制裁恶有恶报。而玄灭也在过程中败亡，留下玄嚣太子，延续葬天关魔城扩张的计划，最终对上倦收天与银骠当家。森狱潜伏的势力崛起，大太子玄膑协同蜕变黑后，两人暗中关注著玄嚣太子的一切行为，伺机而作。而一生执著于剑道的玄同，也因为论剑海的评剑会，踏入苦 境，追寻属于自己的剑道。究竟是谁的剑？能给予惋红曲追寻的答案。

programme.desc: 神州动荡，武林危难，森狱大举入侵，逆海崇帆灭亡，黑海森狱崛起，玄嚣太子领导众多强将，一举攻陷武林。同为皇储，玄灭太子也伺机而出，与玄嚣一争苦境版图，要将森狱版图扩张至苦境，完成个人霸业，以便未来继承阎王之位。道门六杰挺身而出，倦收天与银骠当家等携手抵抗，唯慕峥嵘私心自用，导致无辜伤亡，最终遭受制裁恶有恶报。而玄灭也在过程中败亡，留下玄嚣太子，延续葬天关魔城扩张的计划，最终对上倦收天与银骠当家。森狱潜伏的势力崛起，大太子玄膑协同蜕变黑后，两人暗中关注著玄嚣太子的一切行为，伺机而作。而一生执著于剑道的玄同，也因为论剑海的评剑会，踏入苦 境，追寻属于自己的剑道。究竟是谁的剑？能给予惋红曲追寻的答案。

programme.title: 整你的人生第7集
programme.desc: 男主角凡舍得误打误撞成为了「断舍离大师」。他与杂志记者袁满盈合作，开了一家替人整理家居的公司。透过帮客户整理房间的各种逗趣、写实案例，探讨现代人如何舍弃过剩生活中非必要的物品、事情、压抑的人际关系与情感。在去芜存青的过程中，带领大家重拾生活中最简单也最重要的东西。

programme.title: 少年白马醉春风第16集
programme.desc: 故事讲述在江湖中，顾家与晏家两大势力争夺魁首，而此时，一位年轻的酒肆老板白东君与江湖浪客司空长风卷入其中，与各方势力展开斗争，展现热血少年们的江湖冒险与成长。

programme.title: 霹雳朝灵阙第14集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，无暇暗劫起，猂族利用地狱鸟力量，动荡苦境之后，雌伏多年的暗劫八无暇，也趁势再出，为阻止这股邪恶势力颠覆中原武林，汤问梦泽山座白象．香六牙，广发天下举锋帖，召开擎天会，聚集西窗月、墨如鸦、不全鹰等汤问英杰，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道释代表相继响应，血漫河山侠骨烈，亘古之争，胜败由天抑由人？

programme.desc: 三十九岁依然单身的秀敏与寡母同住，但是母亲最大的心愿就是改变两人世界，为秀敏找到可以托付的人，表面上并非自愿一起生活的两个人，大大小小的摩擦闭上眼睛都可以想像。因此秀敏皮包失窃后便极力隐瞒，希望可以换得短暂的平静。没想到说谎被拆穿的过程更是难堪。最后秀敏终于一一补齐皮包内的衣物，但他惊觉母亲不认得她了。秀敏发现她和母亲经历过的并不是只有人生过半的唏嘘，她们曾经互相生命的印记，但是她再也找不回她生命中最重要的认证了。

programme.title: 杨桃第1集

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第284集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 巴里嘎里岛第1集
programme.desc: 在浩瀚的海洋中有座梦幻之岛，这里住著热情活泼的「嘎里国」和美丽优雅的「巴里国」。金光闪闪的守护神「八宝麒麟」，总在月圆之夜的舞会洒下满天祝福的泡泡，大家过得欢乐又幸福。一场盛大婚礼舞会中，祭司阿布拉竟大搞破坏，八宝麒麟因此消失得无影无踪，接连又发生地震、旱灾和传染病……阿布拉的诡计会得逞吗?《巴里嘎里岛》能恢复幸福欢乐的日子吗？

programme.title: 客庄走透透第72集
programme.desc: 这个节目将带领观众们探索台湾各地的客庄，让他们身历其境地感受客家文化的独特风情。

programme.title: 拉拉杂杂有土伯第19集
programme.desc: (2020)「拉拉杂杂」意指各式各样、玲瑯满目。「拉拉杂杂有土伯」内容为客家电视独创，代表各项客家文化的客家宝宝为主角，打造一个网红经纪公司，每一个客家宝宝都是一位YouTuber，他们以客家叠字来诠释多样又有趣...

programme.title: 大将徐傍兴第8集
programme.desc: 一名男子寻访徐外科旧址，欲奉还多年前积欠之医药费，无奈徐傍兴博士已经去世。男子不断访查下，竟意外知晓了这位医学博士不凡的一生…。

programme.title: 日头下‧月光光第41集
programme.desc: 此出为与生活资讯结合的客家戏剧，客语口说艺术的剧场，其中包含了相声竹板快书、以及说文解字，用活泼逗趣的表演方式，来传达客家语言，敬请观众锁定收看！

programme.title: 国际新闻-客观世界第277集
programme.desc: 是一个专注于国际时事的新闻节目，以客观、中立的角度报导全球各地的重要新闻事件。节目内容涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的议题，旨在向观众传递真实可信的消息，让观众全面了解世界各地的动态，增进对国际事务的理解和视野。

programme.title: 停动停动好健康第236集
programme.desc: 《停动停动好健康》是一个关注身体健康的节目，通过介绍和推广健康的生活方式和运动方法，鼓励观众在日常生活中停下脚步，注重运动和健康饮食，增进身体健康和心灵幸福，提高生活质量。这个节目旨在激发观众对健康的关注和重视，让人们更好地照顾自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 地球队好麻吉第6集
programme.desc: 你知道大自然有多少神奇的模样吗？带你一起出发找答案！每一集，我们会到四个不同国家，和世界各地的小朋友一起发现风、花、大树、河流的秘密，让你成为最懂地球的好麻吉，守护我们住的美丽星球！

programme.title: 乡音飘扬客家情第1集
programme.desc: 「乡音飘扬－客家情」音乐演奏会，旨在传承与发扬客家文化精神，演出内容融合传统与创新元素，丰富多元，并邀请在地优秀音乐家与青年学子同台演出。以经典客家乐曲演奏揭开序幕，透过丝竹与弦乐交织，展现客家音乐朴实的韵味；随后登场的山歌独唱，以深情歌声诠释客家人勤奋朴实的精神；对唱段落以呈现传统歌谣你来我往的趣味互动，生动活泼；压轴合唱则以和谐嘹亮的歌声传递团结与传承的精神。诚挚邀请各界莅临，共同聆听乡音，感受客家情怀。

programme.title: 靓靓绿世界第1集
programme.desc: 八个绿色照护故事，让绿手指们学习撇步一秒上手，不是绿手指，也被植物疗愈，花草不再只是花花草草，花草，可以让我们生活妆点得更美好！

programme.title: 福气来了(南方篇)第105集
programme.desc: 《福气来了 南方篇》将延伸至中南部及花东地区，透过节目提供平台，让乡亲朋友能够走进摄影棚，分享他们的故事，并进行互相交流。在东南部的客家庄里，我们能够欣赏到独特的生活方式，美丽如画的田园风光以及多元的文化。让我们在这个地方，畅谈乡亲们的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第534集
programme.desc: 走访客庄邀请两组家庭进行对决，借由家人间的默契一起做料理，品尝彼此完成的美食，进而带领观众了解「感动人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或时令蔬果。

programme.title: 学学嘴学学鼻MV时间第7集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙学语的模样，是所有父母最鲜明的亲子时光，而我们客家人有一个词，生动描述了这个过程：「学嘴学鼻」。全新推出的幼儿节目《学学嘴学学鼻》，就是从这四个字延伸而来的创意。我们塑造了两位默剧小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的逻辑，反过来用画面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑说客语，小丑则会搭配幽默逗趣的肢体语言，呈现每集要学习的关键字。

programme.title: 森林侦探队Ⅲ(北四县腔)第16集
programme.desc: 延续前两季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更额外增加了新的冒险伙伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面对接踵而来的森林任务，大家勇敢、热心且不畏艰难地向彼此伸出援手，尽管过程中充满挑战，却也能在每次的行动中获得意想不到的收获

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(四县腔)第192集

programme.title: 福气来了第69集
programme.desc: 为一民生消费资讯的访谈性节目，邀请知名中西医疗专家、营养师，为乡亲解惑；更结合运动养身，教学瑜珈、太极和律动等项目。同时，也会介绍客庄各地的活动、农特产品、表演团体等，要给观众们满满的一朝晨。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第35集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 森林侦探队Ⅲ(北四县腔)第16集
programme.desc: 延续前两季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更额外增加了新的冒险伙伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面对接踵而来的森林任务，大家勇敢、热心且不畏艰难地向彼此伸出援手，尽管过程中充满挑战，却也能在每次的行动中获得意想不到的收获

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(四县腔)第192集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一个关于四位好朋友的故事，他们相聚在一起时，总是充满了对话、争吵、欢笑和各种有趣的故事。

programme.title: 星际计程车行第21集
programme.desc: 一对可爱的狐狸兄妹和一只活泼的浣熊，还有搞笑的蓝脚大鸟，他们住在一颗小行星上，经营星际计程车行，载客穿梭于宇宙。尽管竞争对手以接送地位尊贵的乘客策略获得亮眼的业绩，但星际计程车行仍喜欢服务银河系中形形色色的一般乘客。系好安全带，加入我们，享受这趟绝对精采的旅程吧！

programme.title: 足球骑士第32集
programme.desc: 描述热爱足球的两兄弟，在正要自足坛起飞的青少年时期，因一场意外，带走了已是日本U15国脚中场的哥哥逢泽杰，而弟弟逢泽驱则在移植了哥哥的心脏后存活下来，日后逢泽驱记取哥哥的鞭策，重新走上球场，接续朝哥哥的足球梦想前进。

programme.title: 客家戏曲第1191集
programme.desc: 由多个著名客家剧团，分别演出相当脍炙人口的小说故事，希望能让大家再次回味童年看戏的滋味，也能让更多人欣赏到客家的传统大戏。

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第285集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 畅歌实验所单歌第52集
programme.desc: 我们邀请了许多专业的音乐家和创作者担任所长，他们将带给您最好的音乐和创作心情。这个节目的目的是让您在睡前能够享受美妙的歌声，让一整天的紧绷情绪都能够释放出来。此外，我们还会不时地分享一些有关音乐的小知识，让您对音乐有更深入的了解。

programme.title: 客家新闻杂志第1018集
programme.desc: 由陈美祯主持，以客家人的观点，结合时事和近期举办的各种客家活动，做详尽而深入的各种专题探讨和介绍。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第16集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理为起点，透过食材的生产关系、食物的料理过程乃至厨师的烹饪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》试著以人与料理的故事，建立与客家概念的连结与对照，勾勒客家饮食多元丰富的面向。

programme.title: 都市开基祖第7集
programme.desc: 捷运工头阿财，带领工班兄弟参与著隧道工程，为了让女儿学音乐的他，以及各自有梦的工班兄弟，在开挖的隧道中，意外挖出一把诡异的武士刀，随后也接连发生诸多不可思议的巧合；此时，台湾首位女工地主任美莉，也奋力在工地阳刚文化环境中证明著自己，但她也因此，踏上了重重危机的旅途。

programme.title: 学学嘴学学鼻MV时间第8集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙学语的模样，是所有父母最鲜明的亲子时光，而我们客家人有一个词，生动描述了这个过程：「学嘴学鼻」。全新推出的幼儿节目《学学嘴学学鼻》，就是从这四个字延伸而来的创意。我们塑造了两位默剧小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的逻辑，反过来用画面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑说客语，小丑则会搭配幽默逗趣的肢体语言，呈现每集要学习的关键字。

programme.title: 人体内的怪物第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 加州沙加缅度住著一对夫妻，丹欧提斯和珍麦盖瑞。丹对弟弟路易斯非常照顾。某日路易斯出去玩滑板，不到半小时就回家并且出现偏头痛、疲劳、恶心和对光极度敏感等症状。紧急送医后，路易斯时而昏迷，时而清醒，医生和家属都一度以为他嗑药过量，但药物血检结果呈阴性，因此医生安排做X光检查，发现脑里有个水球状的物体，再深入扫描，发现竟然是猪肉绦虫。洁西卡到北卡州上大学，在宿舍读书时突然出现情绪不稳的现象，后来渐渐再出现夜间盗汗、恶心，胸部剧痛，经一次次检查，才发现原来是感染了焦虫。

programme.title: 旧棚新宝物第7季:第4集

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第4季:第17集
programme.desc: 由于上周的估价日活动非常成功，使当铺的存货不于匮乏，因此艾伦和汤决定这次拍卖会要锁定能快速脱手转现的高价品。同时，因为估价日活动带来了人潮，也带来噪音和混乱，使得附近邻居打电话向房东抱怨。房东多次打电话与艾伦和汤连络未果，这次决定自己上门理论。由于当铺的区位绝佳，艾伦和汤都不乐见房东收回店面；同时他们在拍卖会上遇到了黑人兄弟宿敌，而这个拍卖会的地点又是在对方的地盘上，情势对汤和艾伦来说不甚乐观…。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第4季:第18集
programme.desc: 因为本周洛杉矶完全没有举办拍卖会，加上当铺的存货很少，所以汤和艾伦大老远往北到圣巴巴拉参加拍卖会。圣巴巴拉是退休富人的小天地，也使它成为仓储挖宝人的天堂。现场的买家之中有一位开二手商店的老太太，是仓储拍卖的狠角色；艾伦和汤两人戏称他是101忠狗电影中的坏女人。艾伦和对方进入了激烈的竞标战，双方互不相让；为了争一口气，艾伦以高价标下一间旧货仓库和一艘古董木船，让汤著实捏了一把冷汗。

programme.title: 原始生活21天第9季:第12集
programme.desc: 忠实观众莎拉和法兰克将尝试位于南美洲东岸外海的托巴哥岛上，挑战原始生活14天。这片草木茂密的热带丛林，生长在崎岖锐利的火山岩上，遍地爬满有毒的蜈蚣、毒蝎、咬人的黑蚂蚁和成千上万的吸血蚊虫。法兰克是油漆工，具备优秀的野外技能，但他捕捉小猎物的技能将在这种环境下受到严峻的考验；莎拉是杂技表演者，个性特立独行，可能影响她在团队中的野外求生能力。在潮湿的丛林中待了五天后，莎拉的背伤旧疾发作，疼痛不已；就在她辛苦挣扎的时候，队友法兰克想到了灵丹妙药，缓解了莎拉的背痛问题。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注急流篇第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 得知卫斯意外落水的消息后，达斯汀、卡罗斯和詹姆斯准备赶去救援，却在此时遇上汽船的电池没电。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注急流篇第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 达斯汀与卡罗斯因为潜水时数的问题起了争执，一发不可收拾到可能导致采金季终结。

programme.title: 澳洲蛋白石猎人第6季:第3集
programme.desc: 团队的精神领袖过世后，木卡男孩队苦苦挣扎，这季开季就很不顺利；奇尔氏队只剩下克里斯跟奥斯卡父子两人；泛滥成灾的大水淹没了蛋白石细语者队的自有矿区。

programme.title: 建筑巨擘-环海翡翠轮第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 环海翡翠轮位居台湾再生能源转型的核心，可以在海上吊装重达4000公吨的离岸风机构件，节目介绍打造它的团队如何克服种种困难及时交船运作。

programme.title: 抢标房地产第1季:第21集
programme.desc: 卢的表弟来到城里，在寻找度假小屋，史考特和卢发誓要替他找到完美的房地产。克莉丝汀娜和寇特成功标下他们在凤凰城的第二栋房子。道格标下一栋六房屋。究竟谁能赚钱，谁又会赔钱呢？

programme.title: 抢标房地产第1季:第22集
programme.desc: 道格和史考特间再度掀起战火，史考特因为没有标到房子，因此朝道格的车子撒尿。艾德标下了五户复合式出租公寓，约翰标下了似乎有人居住的小屋。究竟谁的房屋能赚钱，谁的又会赔钱呢？

programme.title: 旧货猎人第20季:第18集
programme.desc: 在一间帽子染印厂，薛卡买下专为童工手工打造的凳子。在一座海滨露天游乐场，阿利发现了一位秀场大师的艺术品。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 杰洛米韦德来到美国南部的德州，实地寻找传言中屡屡攻击人类的河中巨怪:鳄雀鳝。据说这种生物凶猛如鲨、体型如鳄，而且拥有尖锐无比的牙齿与坚硬无比的鱼鳞。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗第22季:第2集
programme.desc: 数十年来，船队首次深入遥远北方，追捕一种罕见、近乎神话般的混种帝王蟹，体型更大、肉更多，价值更是不菲。为了捕捉这些珍贵帝王蟹，船长们被迫驶入未知海域，穿越破碎浮冰，迎战节目迄今拍摄过最猛烈的风暴。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第20季:第19集
programme.desc: 薇琪、薛卡和杰展开寻宝之旅，寻觅顾客喜爱的收藏品。

programme.title: 抢标房地产第1季:第23集
programme.desc: 渴望买下第一百栋租屋的史考特在灵媒的相助下，能顺利完成梦想吗？艾德在湖泊社区标下一栋房子，但房子真的紧邻著湖泊吗？道格为了买下理想房屋，因此使出臭臭弹的手段，逼退其他买家。

programme.title: 抢标房地产第1季:第24集
programme.desc: 史考特要带孩子去上学，所以请卢去检视房子。道格买下了一栋他认为后院有内建式烤肉架的房子。经过多次失败后，约翰重金标下一栋位于顶级社区的房子。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注第16季:第4集
programme.desc: 派克向米契施压，要求交出硫磺溪矿区的黄金，最终收获丰硕成果。巴兹在无人看好的矿地上有了新发现。东尼则使出高压手段来测试新工头的极限。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注第16季:第5集

programme.desc: 杰洛米韦德要调查体型微小，但侵略性惊人的食人鱼。1976年，一则巴士失事掉落亚马逊河，造成39人死亡的报导，让食人鱼声名大噪。

programme.title: 姜成镐狂野时速第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 在日本，姜成镐会见了几位热血车迷，感受到汽车文化背后的坚持与热情。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第13季:第4集
programme.desc: 麦克买下一台1965年出厂的荒原路华系列二，他和艾德计划将它打造成一台无所不至的终于逃生车，足以在末日浩劫中逃出生天。

programme.title: 台湾无比精采-科技新生活
programme.desc: 宝创公司开发高科技玻璃，通电时，液晶分子会排列整齐，光线可以通过，薄膜呈透明状，不通电时，液晶分子会让光线散射，薄膜呈雾化状。并用目前的技术开发创新，把透明的电子零组件做在3C商品。兴采公司的陈国钦把咖啡渣当黄金。经过一种熔化的动作，就可以做抽纱的动作，抽纱完后，就可以把功能性母粒加进去，就成为咖啡纱，又具有保特瓶功能的一种环保纱线。亚太燃料电池公司开发燃料电池机车，是台湾唯一把氢气当燃料的公司。大型电池只有供应纯氢气才会运作，这些电池将氢氧化学反应的能量，转化为电力。台?将制作精盐的排放水回收，碱性水变成有利可图的商品，由于碱性水的分子比纯水较小，身体更容易吸收，还可以增进新陈代谢，清除体内

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第4季:第17集
programme.desc: 由于上周的估价日活动非常成功，使当铺的存货不于匮乏，因此艾伦和汤决定这次拍卖会要锁定能快速脱手转现的高价品。同时，因为估价日活动带来了人潮，也带来噪音和混乱，使得附近邻居打电话向房东抱怨。房东多次打电话与艾伦和汤连络未果，这次决定自己上门理论。由于当铺的区位绝佳，艾伦和汤都不乐见房东收回店面；同时他们在拍卖会上遇到了黑人兄弟宿敌，而这个拍卖会的地点又是在对方的地盘上，情势对汤和艾伦来说不甚乐观…。
